why: Removed no-fly zones let UAS enter restricted airspace; unsecured API makes attack plausible, serious safety and regulatory consequences.
Poisoned SSOT corrupts all dependent services simultaneously; single point of failure with broad cascading impact.
Third-party weather and traffic feeds are exposed and easily spoofed; impact limited to routing degradation.
Log tampering conceals incidents and breaks audit obligations; no direct physical harm or operational loss.
Stolen API keys and credential stuffing are common; bulk flight data exfiltration causes data-protection breaches.
SQL injection and unpatched servers are heavily exploited; mass record corruption degrades all data-dependent services.
Tampered authority audit logs let violations go unpunished; reputational and regulatory harm, limited operational effect.
Ambiguity-based loopholes are credible over deployment lifetime; systemic governance gap but slow, indirect safety effect.
Insider or espionage leak of risk register and strategy gives adversaries intelligence; no immediate operational impact.
Unauthenticated civil GNSS is trivially jammed and spoofed; widely seen attacks, safety-critical positioning loss.
C2 link jamming of BVLOS flights is easy and common; uncontrolled drones risk collisions and ground injuries.
Unsigned firmware and exposed debug ports enable persistent compromise; requires physical or update access, many CVEs.
Power loss halts ground station operations; BMS manipulation is harder; mission aborts or uncontrolled landings.
Sensor spoofing and IMU manipulation cause crashes but need proximity or specialist capability; localized impact.
Physical sabotage of vertiport controls needs on-site access; safety risk to UAM but limited likelihood and reach.
Backdoored vendor firmware compromises entire fleets persistently; catastrophic breadth, supply-chain attacks are rarer but real.
Weak identity proofing and stolen credentials are common; unaccountable operators undermine enforcement and shared-airspace safety.
GNSS replay and false telemetry hide real conflicts and create phantom traffic; collision risk, plausible injection.
JWT none-algorithm bypass is well-known and easy; illegal flights authorised in restricted airspace draw major regulatory attention.
Unprotected API gateway is highly exposed to DDoS; total USSP outage grounds all flights, mainly availability impact.
Fake geofence injection lets UAS enter restricted zones; needs feed compromise, serious safety and compliance consequences.
